title: Comfort Club Cancellation Schedule: Refund Window, Cancellation Fee and Visit Retail Values
content:
For every tier of the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, the cancellation schedule fixes the full-refund window, the cancellation fee charged outside it, and the retail values charged back for visits completed in the term when a cancellation credit is computed.

| Tier | Full-refund window (calendar days after term start) | Cancellation fee outside the window (USD) | Retail value per completed tune-up (USD) | Retail value per completed whole-home visit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 30 | 25.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 30 | 25.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 30 | 0.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 30 | 0.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 30 | 0.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 30 | 0.00 | 109.00 | 139.00 |

## Terms used

- **Full-refund window**: the calendar days after term start within which a cancellation gets the full-refund treatment.
- **Cancellation fee**: the fee charged on a cancellation outside the full-refund window; 0.00 means none.
- **Tune-up retail value**: the retail value charged back for each completed tune-up when a cancellation credit is computed.
- **Whole-home visit retail value**: the retail value charged back for each completed whole-home visit when a cancellation credit is computed.

## Quick answers
- **Which tiers carry a cancellation fee?** Comfort Club Basic and Comfort Club Silver, at 25.00 USD each; the four upper tiers show 0.00.
- **Do the retail values differ by tier?** No. The tune-up retail value is 109.00 USD and the whole-home visit retail value 139.00 USD on all six tiers.
